title: Which Eviction Policy Should an LLM Cache Use? A Systematic Study Across Workloads, Capacities, and Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.20280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic caches reuse an LLM response when the incoming query embedding lies near a cached query, but proposed eviction policies have rarely been compared under one protocol. Using CLEVER, we evaluate FIFO, LRU, LFU, ARC, GDSF, a single-pass streaming adaptation of SISO, and a semantic-redundancy policy across three ordered, deduplicated query corpora, three cache capacities, and two encoders. No evaluated policy improves on LFU by more than 0.041 percentage points in any of the eighteen settings. Replacement is not irrelevant: FIFO and streaming SISO trail LFU by as much as 8.67 and 8.55 points, respectively, at tight capacity.   We explain the missing upside with a conditional packing result. Under exact lookup and insert-on-miss, a newly inserted entry cannot have a resident neighbor within the hit radius, so a geometry-aware eviction rule receives little new redundancy signal. A separate audit exposes a larger problem with the eval

translated_title: 大语言模型缓存应使用哪种驱逐策略？跨工作负载、容量和编码器的系统研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20280v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当传入查询嵌入位于缓存查询附近时，语义缓存会重用大语言模型的响应，但提议的驱逐策略很少在统一协议下进行比较。使用CLEVER，我们评估了FIFO、LRU、LFU、ARC、GDSF、SISO的单遍流式适应版本以及一种语义冗余策略，涵盖三个有序、去重的查询语料库、三种缓存容量和两种编码器。在十八种设置中，没有任何评估策略在LFU基础上提升超过0.041个百分点。替换并非无关紧要：在紧凑容量下，FIFO和流式SISO分别落后LFU高达8.67和8.55个百分点。我们用条件打包结果解释了缺失的上行空间。在精确查找和未命中插入的情况下，新插入的条目在命中半径内不能有驻留邻居，因此几何感知的驱逐规则接收到的新冗余信号很少。一项独立审计揭示了评估中的更大问题。
tldr: 本论文系统比较多种缓存驱逐策略，发现LFU在多数情况下表现最优，但所有策略改进空间有限，并通过条件打包结果解释了语义缓存中几何感知驱逐策略的优势受限。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares multiple cache eviction policies, finds LFU performs best in most cases with limited improvement room, and explains via a conditional packing result why geometry-aware eviction policies have limited advantage in semantic caches.
